description: Defines the interface for a DatagramClientSocket class used for UDP socket communication in the Chromium project, including connection methods, network binding, socket tagging, and configuration options.

classes.name: DatagramClientSocket
classes.description: An abstract class representing a UDP datagram socket client with methods for connecting, binding to networks, applying socket tags, and configuring socket options.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initializes the socket as a client to a server at the specified address; can only be called once.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific network and connects to the server at the given address.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Connects the socket using the current default network to the specified address.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects the socket to the specified address.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously binds the socket to a specific network and connects to the server.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects the socket using the default network.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle the socket is bound to, or invalid if not explicitly bound.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for network traffic identification.

methods.name: EnableRecvOptimization
methods.description: Enables experimental receive optimization; no-op by default.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the network interface for multicast traffic; must be called before connect methods.

methods.name: SetIOSNetworkServiceType
methods.description: Sets the iOS network service type; no-op by default.
